for: Independent medical or dental practices with a CMS revalidation due date
A practice admin or authorized official who can attest in PECOS
not: Billing companies that already run PECOS as a product
Anyone who wants us to log in or click Submit
faq: Do you need our PECOS password?
No. You keep the login. We send a packet your official uses in one sitting.
Can you guarantee CMS accepts it?
No. We assemble a complete file. Acceptance stays with CMS and your official.
How fast?
Five business days for one enrollment record after we have the NPI and due month.

for: US shared kitchens and small copackers that must renew in the 2026 window
An owner who still has the FDA account
not: Foreign facilities that need a US Agent
Anyone who wants us to hold the FURLS login
faq: Is the 2026 window still open?
Yes. October 1 through December 31, 2026. After that the registration expires.
Will you submit for us?
No. The owner submits. We prepare the worksheet and the click path.
How fast?
Three business days per facility.

for: Establishments that must file OSHA injury data electronically
A safety lead who already keeps 300 and 300A logs
not: Companies that want us to decide what is recordable
Anyone asking us to speak to OSHA
faq: March 2 already passed. Too late?
OSHA still accepts the file through December 31. We also set next year's weekly log.
Do you decide recordability?
No. That stays with you. We clean the file and list questions only you can answer.
How fast?
Setup in one week, then a monthly hygiene pass.

for: Small FSIS plants that print Product of USA or Made in USA
A QA lead who can sign the plant file
not: Plants that want us to obtain USDA label approval
Anyone asking us to certify origin
faq: Is this USDA approval?
No. We map the evidence file. LSAS and approval stay with you.
What do you need from us?
Current labels plus whatever origin records you already have.
How fast?
Ten business days for one establishment.

for: Residential solar installers who keep missing completeness checks
An ops manager who can get the engineer to stamp
not: Anyone who wants us to stamp electrical drawings
We do not submit as contractor of record
faq: Do you design the system?
No. We completeness-check the packet against that utility's list.
What if the utility already bounced us?
Send the bounce. We turn it into a punch list and a resubmit pack.
How fast?
Two business days per application.

for: US Shopify brands with Shopping listings down on price or availability
An ecommerce lead who can publish feed and page fixes
not: Stores that want us to run Google Ads
Anyone who will not give a Diagnostics export
faq: Will Google approve us again?
We cannot promise that. We give you the SKU ledger and the exact fixes.
Do you need our Merchant Center login?
No. Export Diagnostics and three product URLs.
How fast?
Five business days for up to 200 flagged SKUs.

for: US Vendor Central brands with operational chargebacks on the defect list
A vendor ops or finance lead who can upload disputes
not: Seller Central consumer card chargebacks
Anyone who wants a guaranteed reversal
faq: Is this Seller Central A-to-Z?
No. This desk is Vendor Central operational chargebacks only.
Will Amazon reverse the fees?
We build the evidence packet. Amazon decides. Identified is not cash.
How fast?
Setup in one week, then a weekly batch.

for: Licensed home-service trades with a suspended Google Business Profile
An owner who can upload license and address proof once
not: Agencies looking for monthly SEO
Anyone who wants a guaranteed reinstatement
faq: Can you guarantee we come back on Maps?
No. We build one clean appeal packet. Google decides.
Should we keep appealing?
No. One packet. Stacked appeals usually make it worse.
How fast?
Three business days.

for: Experience-rated US contractors with a new mod worksheet
A controller who can send the claim listing to their broker
not: Anyone who wants us to sell insurance or change the mod
Firms whose broker already reconciled the sheet
faq: Will this lower our premium?
Only if the worksheet is wrong and your broker files. We find mismatches.
Do you need carrier access?
No. Send the worksheet you already have plus the claim list.
How fast?
Seven business days for one rating year.

for: Specialty subcontractors with a public award who cannot get on site
A PM who has the exhibit and a broker
not: Anyone who wants us to decide if coverage is enough
We do not bind insurance
faq: Do you issue certificates?
No. Your broker issues. We chase, match, and pack.
What do you need?
The award, the insurance exhibit, and current certs.
How fast?
Setup in three days, then a twice-weekly chase.

for: Independent specialty clinics with a missing-info queue
An office manager who will sign a BAA before any PHI
not: Clinics that want us to write medical necessity
Anyone who will not sign a BAA
faq: Is this clinical?
No. We chase status and missing-info. Clinicians decide necessity.
When do you see patient data?
Only after a signed BAA. Until then, process only.
How fast?
Daily queue once onboarded.

for: Multi-unit independent restaurants with messy Monday closes
A bookkeeper who already exports the POS
not: Groups that want us to file sales tax
Anyone asking for tax advice
faq: Do you file the return?
No. Your CPA files. We send the exception pack.
Which POS?
Whatever you already export. Toast and Square are common.
How fast?
Every Monday for the prior week.

for: Licensed HVAC shops with finished jobs and unfiled utility rebates
An office manager who can send invoice and equipment photos
not: Anyone who wants an eligibility opinion we will stand behind
We do not promise the utility pays

No. This desk files live utility mail-in packets on completed jobs.

It goes on the not-ready list. We do not invent evidence.
How fast?
Four business days per packet.

for: Independent pharmacies whose remits do not match claims
An owner or PIC starting with one PBM
not: Anyone who wants legal advice on DIR disputes

No. The ledger keeps those columns separate on purpose.
Do you need full PHI?
Send remits and claim exports. Redact where you can.
How fast?
Monthly, ten business days after you send remits.

for: Independent appliance or HVAC shops with rejected labor claims
An owner who still has the job photos
not: Shops that already run a full warranty platform
Anyone who wants a payment promise

We rebuild the pack they asked for. Payment stays with them.

It goes on a do-not-resubmit list. We do not keep billing a dead claim.
How fast?
Two business days per claim.

for: Independent hotels with virtual-card short pays or unbilled no-shows

Whatever posts a virtual card against your folio.

Nightly file, pack the next morning.
